# cubepath_ddos_prefix_list (Resource)

Manages a DDoS prefix list: a named set of source networks that protection profiles can block or allow (prefix_list_ids). Up to 3 lists per organization and 100 entries per list. Import with the list UUID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique in the organization, up to 64 characters. Changing it forces a new list.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, up to 255 characters. Changing it forces a new list.
- `entries` (Set of String) Networks in CIDR notation (a single IP is written as /32 or /128). Changed in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The UUID of the prefix list.
